summary: BHP Group Limited furnished a Form 6-K on 15 September 2026 containing its Notice of Meeting and Chair's invitation for the 2026 Annual General Meeting, to be held 22 October 2026 at 10:00am Sydney time. The circular recounts FY2026 results, a US$8.7 billion total distribution equal to 172 US cents per share (66 per cent of underlying attributable profit), board renewal with Mark Vassella appointed 1 June 2026, and the CEO transition from Mike Henry to Brandon Craig effective 1 July 2026. This is a routine AGM notice and proxy solicitation, not a special situation; no transaction terms, advisors or regulatory clock are stated.
